fix: In moss peristome descriptions 'teeth' means the exostome teeth (peristome tooth, PO_0030043), not phyllome lamina tooth (PO_0025515). Ground the comparison target with the moss/peristome context.
reason: The endostome segments are as long as the exostome teeth. The comparison target was grounded to leaf-lamina teeth, so the relation points to the wrong part. Bearer and ratio are otherwise right.
The leaves are said to be reddish, so approximately red on the leaf is right.

target: distance (PATO_0000040), 0.3 cm, towards the next areole
fix: 'N unit apart' is a measured spacing. Annotate distance with the number. Do not map 'apart' to FLOPO distant (widely separated), which is a qualitative value.
reason: The flora gives a measured spacing of 0.3 cm. It does not say the areoles are widely separated, and 0.3 cm is close.

fix: 'margin serrulate/crenate/serrate' describes the margin. Use leaf margin (PO_0020128) when the leaf is the whole, not leaf lamina.
reason: Serrulate-crenate is said of the margin. The continuum reading of the qualities is fine.

fix: Selaginella 'axillary leaves' are a specific leaf kind. A position slot (axillary) would be more exact, but without it the alternative is still true.
reason: Axillary leaves are said to be asymmetrical or symmetrical. Leaf symmetry with both values matches.
The stipules are brownish.
The spikelets are 0.9 mm wide.
The inflorescences have 3-7 flowers, and the inflorescence is set as the container.
The flowers are axillary or subterminal, both values of position.
In FNA, the second dimension of a plant's height × width is its width. 0.5-2(-3) dm converts correctly to 5-20(-30) cm.
The flowering stalk (scape) is more or less erect. In PO, scape is a synonym of stem, and 'more or less' becomes approximately.
The fruits are purple-black when mature. The head colour is black, and the mature context is set.
The stipules are fused to the petiole bases (PO_0008024 petiole proximal end).
The inflorescence is few-flowered: flowers are present with the count word 'few' in the inflorescence.
There are 10 stamens.

fix: In 'Corolla ..., lobes X long, hairy at the apex' the later qualities belong to the lobes, the last subject named, not the corolla.
reason: The flora says the corolla lobes are stiffly hairy at the apex, not the corolla. 'Stiffly hairy' could also be hispid (PATO_0002339), but the bearer is the main error.

target: position: outer sepal; whole: staminate flower
fix: When the sentence names 'N outer sepals ... , M inner sepals ...', keep the outer/inner position. Keep the 'Male flowers:' heading as the whole.
reason: Only the 3 outer sepals of male flowers are 1.5 mm wide. The inner sepals are 2(-3) mm wide, so 'sepals 1.5 mm wide' is false for them.

fix: 'ca. N' should also set value_qualifier approximately.
reason: There are about 20 stamens. The number is right but the 'ca.' qualifier is missing.

fix: 'blades' means leaf lamina (PO synonym 'leaf blade'), not the whole leaf. In sedges and grasses the leaf includes the sheath.
reason: The blades of vegetative culms are shorter than the culm. The comparison target, stem/culm, is right.
The stamens are subequal: size approximately equal (FLOPO_0991102), as intended for subequal.
The leaflets are 2-4 cm wide.
There are (20-)30-50 carpels, with min extreme 20.
The corolla is at first white, so white with the young context is right.

fix: 'secondary veins N on each side of midvein' are the lateral leaf veins, as already done for 'lateral veins' (cf. A06445). Do not stop at generic vascular bundle.
reason: The count is of secondary (lateral) veins of the leaflet. Vascular bundle is too broad and does not match the each-side position.

fix: A trailing 'beneath'/'below' after a pubescence term means the abaxial surface and must fill the place slot.
reason: Only the lower surface of the leaflets is said to be pubescent to velvety. The continuum values are right.
There are 2 or 3 lateral veins on each side of the midrib.
The leaves are up to 0.5 mm wide, with a maximum only.
Chaffy bracts are dry, thin and membranous, which matches scarious texture.
The anther is 4 mm long.
The flowers are borne in a dichasial cyme. In PO, dichasium is a synonym of cyme inflorescence, so its presence is stated.
